newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-MULDER GOAL BOOKS SEMIFINAL PLACE FOR SCHALKE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MULDER GOAL BOOKS SEMIFINAL PLACE FOR SCHALKE.

text.p: An early strike by Youri Mulder helped German club Schalke to a 1-1 draw with Valencia in the UEFA Cup quarter-final second leg on Tuesday and ensured them a place in the semifinals.
Schalke's 3-1 aggregate win gave the German league a measure of revenge over the Spanish team who had opened their European campaign by knocking out Bayern Munich.

Schalke, who led 2-0 from the first leg, went ahead in the 18th minute when a mix-up in midfield let Mulder through the middle of the Valencia defence and he easily beat goalkeeper Andoni Zubizarreta.
Valencia received a major boost just before halftime when Antonio Poyatos rose above the German defence to head home a cross from the right by Enrique Romero.
The Spaniards continued to press but solid defending from the visitors prevented Valencia from converting their superior second-half possession into more goals.
